name: Crispy Air Fryer Halloumi Bites

cookwares.name: ideally one with a glass basket or window

ingredients.name: halloumi cheese block, cut into 1- to 1 1/2–inch cubes
neutral oil, such as vegetable or canola oil

instructions.primary_message: Pat halloumi cubes dry with paper towels. In a medium bowl, toss halloumi cubes with oil until evenly coated.

Arrange halloumi cubes in an air fryer basket in a single layer with space between each cube. Depending on the size of your air fryer, you might need to cook in batches (don't crowd the pieces, or the sides won't brown well).
Cook the halloumi in an air fryer heated to 204°C until golden brown, flipping the pieces with tongs halfway through cooking, 14 to 20 minutes total.
Use tongs to transfer halloumi to a serving platter. Drizzle with honey, if using, or add to a salad. Serve immediately (halloumi will firm up again and become more squeaky upon cooling).

schema_metadata.keywords: Crispy Air Fryer Halloumi Bites Recipe, halloumi recipe

description: Make crispy air-fryer halloumi bites in minutes. Cubing the cheese maximizes surface area for golden edges and a gooey center. Serve as a party appetizer or toss into a weekday salad.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Honey or hot honey, for serving (optional)

Notes: If you prefer the halloumi in slabs, cut the block into roughly 1.5-cm-thick slabs and cook following the recipe instructions, but note it may take longer to cook. For cubes, note that, depending on the shape of the block of halloumi, it may be easier to cut it into 1- or 1 1/2–inch pieces.

Make-ahead and storage: Air-fried halloumi is best eaten immediately after cooking; if left out, it will harden and take on an unpleasant chewy texture.
author: Grace Kelly
